shape_construction: Believable task-specific proportions, silhouettes, construction, joins and object anatomy. Generic boxes, disconnected pipes, floating parts and unclosed architectural gaps are substantive defects. Judge intended stylization, not polygon count.
materials: Appropriate authored material vocabulary, scale, surface differentiation and consistency. Default/checker surfaces, indiscriminate tiling and texture pasted over primitive geometry do not establish finish. Do not demand wear where not requested.
lighting: Exposure, readable surfaces, shadow depth, light/material relationships across all important zones. Burnt-out whites, persistent darkness, flat unreadable surfaces and pervasive glare lower quality even if objects exist.
composition: Spatial hierarchy, focal readability, coherent massing and purposeful distribution at overview, street/room and close scales. Empty space is not inherently bad; unjustified barren requested working or inhabited zones are.
detail: Meaningful task-specific equipment, furnishing and environmental detail at large/medium/small scales. Repeated colored boxes, labels and token props cannot stand in for differentiated functional objects or rich requested spaces.
style: Match the requested/reference visual language across all zones. Real environments require plausible construction and material treatment; voxel/game styles require intentional resolved abstraction. Do not penalize coherent low-poly/voxel design for not being photorealistic.
scene_coverage: Substantive realization of the public brief and reference scene extent, connected zones, context and principal architectural/environmental features. Judge the realized scene, not merely presence counts or labels. Avoid requiring identical camera or incidental photograph clutter.
functional_identity: Visible differentiation and credible furnishing of required functional areas and mechanisms. A named room with token objects is partial credit. Compare defining reference features when supplied. Do not infer actual interactive success from appearance.

formula: continuous quality anchored to visible completion; coverage and deviation retained separately as diagnostics

environment.criterion: The village forms a loose diagonal chain across the central landscape, with an isolated house branching toward the lower left and a larger building cluster toward the lower right.
Open grassland occupies most of the scene and continues into distant rolling hills; the village remains the focal area within this broad landscape.
Buildings, paths, trees and terrain share a consistent cubic block scale, with stepped edges and visibly pixelated surfaces.
Buildings sit grounded on terrain, and connected paths negotiate elevation changes with coherent block steps and clear approaches to visible entrances.
Bright daylight, a predominantly fresh green palette and directional tree and building shadows establish the sunny, open countryside atmosphere.

features.criterion: Small detached rectangular houses have varied footprints and predominantly steep, stepped gable roofs.
Roof ridges, overhanging eaves and repeated horizontal stair courses create the distinctive block-built roof profiles.
Low doorway and window openings punctuate simple walls, with visible timber corner framing on several houses.
Pale golden wood roofs contrast with gray stone walls and bases, using coarse pixel textures.
Gray flat-topped stone sections among the upper village buildings and a low tiered wooden form in the lower-right cluster interrupt the repeated gabled silhouettes.
Broad rolling slopes are built from densely repeated block-height terraces with angular, irregular contour lines.
Steep banks and shallow gullies interrupt flatter village clearings, especially along the left side.
Green grass caps sit over exposed brown dirt faces along terrace edges.
Localized dark openings and exposed gray stone cuts break the grassy slopes on the right.
Scattered trees have narrow upright trunks and irregular crowns composed of stacked cubic leaf masses.
Broad low crowns mix with occasional taller narrow crowns across the hills.
Trees remain widely spaced, leaving extensive open pasture and clear village approaches.
Mottled dark-green foliage and brown trunks contrast with lighter ground grass; small grass tufts cover much of the terrain.
Narrow ochre paths form an irregular branching network through the building clusters.
Path edges turn in square block increments and widen locally beside houses and junctions.
The southwest branch descends across terraces toward the detached lower-left house.
Flat sandy-tan pixelated surfaces remain clearly distinct from surrounding green grass.
Blue water enters the landscape at both lower corners, with a larger visible expanse at the lower right.
Shorelines follow angular block steps beneath grassy banks, with pale sand visible at the lower-left inlet.
Saturated blue, subtly pixel-patterned water contrasts strongly with green banks and pale sand.
